name: cg_asset_platforms
description:
Blockchain networks (asset platforms) known to CoinGecko (asset_platforms), such as ethereum, solana or polygon-pos.
Returns {platforms: [{id, chain_identifier, name, shortname, native_coin_id, ...}]}.
Inputs: none.
Platform ids appear in coin details (cg_coin_info platforms) and NFT entries (cg_nft_list).
Example: {}
